nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Dawn on the Old Weighbridge as the Millgate harvest swap-market wakes; carts unload, chalk price boards go up along the pear row, and Auntie Pell sends Idris to open the seed stall with a fistful of brass swap-tokens for the day'>>

choices.label: Open the seed stall for trade

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=75 beats='Idris turns the tokens over on the seed sacks and two of them do not match; one star is punched clean through the brass and one is only pressed into it, and the whole market is spending both without a word'>>

choices.label: Count the tokens in the jar
Read the chalk price boards
Take a mug to Nana Bevel

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=100 beats='Idris tips the seed-stall token jar onto a crate and sorts the brass by feel; some tokens have a star punched clean through the metal, others carry only a stamped star; the punched ones sound different when they drop'>>

choices.label: Look closely at the two stars
Find Mira and watch her haggle
Walk up to the tinshop of Fenn

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=100 beats='Idris walks the pear row reading chalk prices; one board lists two numbers for the same basket and the seller rubs one out when Idris looks; Millgate boards have never needed two numbers before'>>

choices.label: Compare the two stars up close
Watch Mira pay for her onions
Ask the clerk about his token chest

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=100 beats='Nana Bevel pours cider and refuses a stamped-star token, asking for a punched one instead; she will not say why, only that punched tokens spend better up the hill and always have'>>

choices.label: Study the tokens in the sunlight
Look inside the market token chest
Carry a token up to Fenn

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Idris lays two tokens side by side under the awning light; the older minting has a star punched right through the brass, the newer one has a star only pressed into the surface and a slightly wider rim'>>

choices.label: Drop each token on the crate lid
Borrow the beam scale from Sefa
Compare prices along the pear row

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Mira Salk trades a bundle of onions and quietly pays in stamped-star tokens while keeping the punched ones knotted in her sleeve; asked why, she shrugs and says everyone does it'>>

choices.label: Track the prices Mira just paid
Look at the grain sacks of Bram
Listen to how each token rings

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Torren Quill guards the market token chest under the weighbridge desk; Idris watches him sort incoming tokens into two trays without seeming to notice that he is doing it at all'>>

choices.label: Weigh a handful on the beam scale
Climb to the loft of Old Fenn
Go and count the sacks of Bram

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Old Fenn the tinsmith once ran the token press for the market guild; his shop smells of solder and hot brass, and he goes very quiet when Idris sets a stamped-star token on his bench'>>

choices.label: Ask to see the old press dies
Test how the two tokens ring
Check who is hoarding heavy brass

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Idris drops each token on the crate lid; the punched star rings long and thin, the stamped star lands with a dull click; Mira makes Idris do it twenty times before she will believe it'>>

choices.label: Sort the whole jar by its ring
Find Weighmaster Sefa Dunn
Count the price on every stall

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Sefa Dunn lets Idris set ten tokens of each minting on the beam scale; the punched ten sit heavier by about the weight of a barley grain, a small difference that shows up every single time'>>

choices.label: Ask Sefa what the guild rule says
Sort the seed-stall jar by weight
Ask every seller one price question

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Idris fills two columns in the tally book and the numbers separate; a basket of pears costs six stamped tokens or five punched ones, and the gap is wider at the top of the row than it was last week'>>

choices.label: Count the price on all thirty stalls
Follow the punched tokens to Bram
Close the book and say nothing

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='In the loft above the tinshop Idris finds two press dies wrapped in oilcloth; the older die has a punch pin, the newer one had its pin snap off years ago and was never repaired'>>

choices.label: Ask Fenn what happened to the pin
Take the dies to Weighmaster Sefa
Let Fenn show the dies and stop there

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Bram the grain factor keeps two money boxes behind his oat sacks; Idris watches him pay out stamped tokens all morning and never once let a punched token leave his hand'>>

choices.label: Watch the boxes of Bram all day
Count what every stall charges
Ask how the tokens were made

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris and Mira sort every token in the seed-stall jar by ring and rim; forty-one stamped, nine punched, and the nine punched ones are the oldest and most worn brass in the jar'>>

choices.label: Chalk both prices on a spare board
Ask Sefa to sign your numbers
Trade the last basket at an honest price

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris walks all thirty-one stalls and asks each seller one question about price; twenty-two of them quietly quote a lower number for punched tokens and none of them names a reason'>>

choices.label: Post the two prices in public
Get the weighmaster seal on it
Say it once and step away

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Fenn explains that when the punch pin snapped the guild told him to keep pressing anyway and to use cheaper brass to save the cost; nobody told the market and nobody wrote it down'>>

choices.label: Ask Fenn to say this out loud
Bring Sefa in as a witness
Put the story to Bram directly

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris shadows Bram until dusk; every punched token that reaches his hand goes into the left money box and never comes back out again, and the left box is nearly full'>>

choices.label: Let Bram see that you noticed
Chalk the drift on your own board
Quietly collect heavy tokens yourself

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Sefa Dunn is the one person at the market whose whole job is to be believed about weight; she listens, weighs a handful herself, and says this is the guild business she has been dreading'>>

choices.label: Ask Sefa to seal the tally page
Fetch Fenn to explain the press
Take the scale to the grain row

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Fenn carries both dies down to the weighbridge and holds up the snapped punch pin; the market understands in one breath that there were always two coins and never a plot, and Idris goes home known as the one who looked closely'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Idris shuts the tally book and spends the tokens without looking at them; by the last day of the harvest swap-market the gap has doubled, the seed stall is short by a whole sack of barley, and nobody ever finds out why'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris chalks both prices on a spare board and props it against the seed stall; three sellers laugh, two rub it out, and one stops to ask Idris where the numbers came from'>>

choices.label: Ask the guild to meet in the open
Say it where everyone can hear
Let the tally book stand as it is

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Sefa Dunn signs the bottom of the page and presses the weighmaster seal into the wax; she warns Idris that a signed page turns a rumour into a charge that somebody has to answer'>>

choices.label: Call the guild to a meeting
Read the page to the whole market
Keep two columns and be honest about it

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Fenn says it plainly at last: two mintings, four harvests, one broken punch pin, and a guild letter he still keeps in a tin telling him to carry on and say nothing about it'>>

choices.label: Put the letter before the guild
Settle it with Bram tonight
Watch the stalls close their shutters

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Bram denies nothing; he offers Idris a swap of two stamped tokens for every punched one, points out that anybody else could have worked it out too, and calls it plain trading'>>

choices.label: Corner Bram with your own numbers
Take the offer to the crowd
Post both prices and leave it there

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Idris and Mira trade the last basket at six stamped or five punched and say the rate out loud to every buyer; three neighbouring stalls copy them by noon and that row ends the harvest on one honest price'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Idris says the true thing once and walks off before anybody can argue; some stalls change their boards and some do not, so the harvest ends with half the market fair and half of it drifting, and a tally book nobody quite finished reading'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Idris starts keeping the punched tokens too, and by the closing bell the jar under the seed sacks is heavy; the trick works exactly as it worked for Bram, and Idris finds that being right and being fair have quietly stopped being the same thing'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=100 beats='The guild agrees to meet on the weighbridge at the opening bell; word runs the length of the market before supper and half the stalls decide they will come and watch'>>

choices.label: Ask Sefa to weigh in public
Step up and speak first
Chalk a rate and let it work

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=100 beats='Traders pack in around the weighbridge three deep; Bram stands at the front with both money boxes, Nana Bevel has her arms folded, and everybody is waiting for somebody to start'>>

choices.label: Start it yourself
Ask for the scale instead of a speech
Walk out of the market for good

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=100 beats='Idris lays the signed page on the oat sacks; Bram reads it twice, agrees that the numbers are honest, and asks what the market is supposed to do about a thing everybody already does'>>

choices.label: Ask Bram to say that in public
Settle the question on the scale
Let the scale settle it for good

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='The chalked board outlasts everyone who rubbed at it, and by dusk four stalls have copied the two columns; Millgate has no new rule yet, but it has a record, and every seller now knows how to check a token before taking it'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Nobody will take brass from anybody; shutters come down before noon on the last day of the harvest swap-market, and Idris stands on the empty weighbridge holding a tally book that was right too loudly and too late'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Millgate keeps both mintings and posts both prices on every board, and Idris rules the two columns on the first board each morning; it is honest, it is more work, and nobody pretends any more that there is only one coin'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=100 beats='Sefa Dunn weighs fifty of each minting while the market watches the beam; the punched fifty tip the scale and hold it down, and nobody in the crowd needs the number explained to them'>>

choices.label: Ask whether the press can be mended
Take the chest key from Torren
Ask the guild to write the rule

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=100 beats='Idris climbs onto the weighbridge stone and starts with the smallest true thing: two mintings, one market, four days of paired prices, and a tally book that anybody present may check'>>

choices.label: Watch the market decide it trusts nobody
Ask to keep the tally for the market
Ask them to honour both stars

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Idris chalks one line across the biggest board, six stamped equals five punched checked by the weighmaster, and every stall trades against it all day; by closing the two mintings are two shapes of the same money again'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Idris hands the tally book to Auntie Pell and goes home before anybody rules on anything; the drift is proved and nobody is fixing it, and the last day of the harvest swap-market trades on in two prices behind him'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='The beam scale stays out on the weighbridge stone from that day on and any trader may ask for a weigh before taking brass; the drift stops within a week, because a scale in plain sight is harder to argue with than a rumour'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='A smith cuts a new punch pin, Fenn sets the old die on the bench, and the press stamps a clean bright token with a star punched right through it; Fenn lets Idris pull the lever for the first one and keeps that token on a nail above the bench'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Everything Idris says is true and it changes nothing; Millgate stops believing in brass altogether and goes back to swapping goods for goods, which is slower and poorer, and Idris keeps a jar of tokens that nobody wants'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Torren hands over the chest key in front of the guild and Idris becomes the youngest keeper the market has ever had; the first job is weighing the whole chest, and the second is teaching Mira the ring of each star'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='The guild writes the Millgate standard into the rule book: one weight, one posted rate, and one chest weighed in public every harvest with the weighmaster watching; Idris is named in the margin as the person who counted'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Millgate makes Idris the keeper of the market tally, a real post with a shelf and a key, and the first entry is the four days of paired prices that started all of it; Mira signs beneath as the second pair of eyes'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='The market keeps both mintings and a posted rate, and Millgate children learn the ring of each star before they learn the prices; nothing is undone, everything is written down, and the drift never gets to be a secret again'>>
